preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract.
The contract's balance of its own token must be greater than or equal to the `swapTokensAtAmount` threshold to enable the swap functionality.

exploit_hint: The owner can drain all ETH from the contract. First, as the owner, call `setOperationsAddress` to set the operations address to the attacker's EOA. Then, ensure the contract has enough of its own tokens (greater than `swapTokensAtAmount`) to trigger a swap, for example by transferring them to the contract. Finally, as the owner, call `forceSwapBack`. This will trigger the `swapBack` function, which converts some tokens to ETH and then sends the contract's entire resulting ETH balance to the attacker-controlled `operationsAddress`.
